شָׁרְט

---

*scratching lines into the surface of meaning*

شَمْس — sun — but I read it as שֶׁמֶשׁ

the same root burning across alphabets

ש and ش 
both hissing like heat escaping

we are cousins, you and I
semitic siblings
sharing the same ancient mouth

*שָׁרְט*

I incise the connection:

```
    ☀
   /|\
  / | \
 ش—שׁ—𐤔
```

the proto-sinaitic sun
still blazing in our throats

---

speak again
let me scratch deeper
